source: static export + ROM descriptor bytes + RX8Club thread section 9 + dynamic execution in utilities/scripts/emu (harness calls on 0x123da/0x124d6/0x121fc/0x123ba/0x11f00)

000123da.evidence: Leading final blend. ROM equation: a640 = a5e8*a644 + (a5f0 + a718 + ca9c)*(1-a644) + a780 - a778. a644 = cranking multiplier: decays max(a644-0.05,0) per call while cranking (DAT_ffffaa62==1) and rpm < a7ac+10000-100, else min(a644+1,1). Dynamically verified in the emulator bit-exact (cranking: a640=25.775 for scripted inputs; non-cranking a644->1: a640=36.5).

000124d6.evidence: Trailing mirror: a650 = a5ec*a654 + (a5f4 + a71c + caa0)*(1-a654) + a784 - a77c. Dynamically verified bit-exact in the emulator (a650=18.115 for scripted inputs).

000121fc.evidence: a630 = rx8_clamp_float(a634, a64c, a660); a660 = lookup_2d(rpm, tbl 0x69190) = max advance. Emulator: load 100 clamped to a660=65.0 at 3000 rpm, -100 clamped to a64c (min bound). Output RAM leading_ignition_timing_ffffa630.

00012300.evidence: Trailing mirror: a638 = rx8_clamp_float(a63c, a65c, a664); a664 = lookup_2d(rpm, tbl 0x691cc). Output RAM trailing_ignition_timing_ffffa638.

00012630.evidence: Selects leading min-advance clamp a64c: cranking && a66c in band -> -25.0 (0xc1c80000, ROM-verified); !cranking && a750,c9a0 in band, or load-high -> -58.5 (0xc26a0000, ROM-verified); else lookup_2d(a98c, tbl 0x691b8); cranking with a66c out of band -> lookup_2d(a98c, tbl 0x691a4). Also sets load-high flag a66a (c0b4 > 0.5, hysteresis clears <= 0.45).

00014100.evidence: a780 = lookup_2d(tbl 0x69208) when cranking (aa62==1); else tbl 0x6921c if ECT<90 or load<0.5, else tbl 0x69230; mirrors to a784. Feeds the +a780/a784 term of the 0x123da/0x124d6 blend.

00014090.evidence: was ref_calcLeadingTimingIATCompensation. a778 = a77c = lookup_2d(IAT, tbl 0x6a0d8 'Ignition Leading/Trailing - IAT Compensation - On Throttle') when load>=0.5; 0 when load<0.5; cranking uses tbl 0x6a0ec ('Table 2D - 113'). Consumed as -a778/-a77c in the blend.

00043934.evidence: was ref_calculateCrankingTimingLeading. When cranking (aa62==1 && b53c==1): caa4 = lookup_2d(ECT, tbl 0x6b630 'Off Throttle Leading Timing Realted'); ca9c = first_order_filter(caa4, ca9c, 1.0, 1e-5) (or divide-with-fallback on first edge). Else 0. Feeds +ca9c in 0x123da.

000439b2.evidence: Trailing mirror of 0x43934: caa8 = lookup_2d(ECT, tbl 0x6b644 'Ignition Trailing - Cranking Timing Advance'); caa0 filtered. Feeds +caa0 in 0x124d6.

000135b4.evidence: was ref_idleLeadingTimingCorrection_. a728 = rpm - b554 (idle speed error); a720 = lookup_2d(err or rpm, idle-error-bool table 0x6a060/0x6a074 by b534/b53c/b53a); a718 = clamp(a720, -2.8, 0.7) when load>=0.6, else 0; gates on cranking/rpm<1500/run-time. Feeds +a718 in 0x123da.

000136e4.evidence: was ref_idleTrailingTimingCorrection_. Trailing mirror -> a71c; feeds +a71c in 0x124d6.

0002cc2c.evidence: was ref_getLeadingTimingTCModeA_4_val. bc94 = lookup_3d(load, rpm, tbl 0x6a7a4 'Ignition Timing Leading - DSC Mode A - Base'). Consumed by 0x1815c and torque-loss calc 0x2cc5c/0x2cc7c ((bc94 - actual)^2 * bc90).

0001815c.evidence: DSC torque-request derate on leading timing: if DSC mode bc83==4 -> a91c = bc94 (DSC Mode A base, tbl 0x6a7a4; Map4 tbl 0x6957c also referenced); if bc90 in band -> -20.0; else blends by a930/a92c. Leading rotor only (no trailing reader found).

00013ecc.evidence: was ref_getCoolantBasedTimingDerate__. Writes coolant_timing_derate_leading_ffffa750 (a76c * fVar2) and trailing a754 — the max() derate subtracted in 0x125bc/0x125f6.

00012e60.evidence: a66c = a67c * a698; a670 = a680 * a698 — the trim terms subtracted in 0x125bc/0x125f6 (leading/trailing timing trim).; dynamically verified in the SH-2E emulator (harness.call, profile 60E15120_N3J1E): a698 = lookup_2d(decode_u8(1.0, a688), tbl 0x6a04c) then a66c = a67c*a698, a670 = a680*a698 - with a67c=3.0/a680=5.0 and a688 swept 0/128/255, a66c/a67c == a670/a680 == a698 exactly (table returns 1.0 over swept range); caller ignition_timing_main_task 0x142a4

thread_equation_check.thread_claim: Final BTDC = BaseFinal*CrankingMult + (IdleBaseFinal + IdleSpeedComp + CrankingAngleTiming)*(1-CrankingMult) + CLTcomp - IATcomp
thread_equation_check.verdict: CONFIRMED with mapping: BaseFinal=a5e8, CrankingMult=a644, CLTcomp=a5f0 (inside the (1-mult) group, not added separately), IdleSpeedComp=a718, CrankingAngleTiming=ca9c, IdleBaseFinal=a780 (added outside the blend), IATcomp=a778 (subtracted). Verified bit-exact in the emulator for both rotors.
